Who We Are
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.
As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.
We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.
 The role
 As the Systems Engineer for Electromagnetic Interference (EMI), you will own the end-to-end EMI/EMC engineering lifecycle for our airborne platforms, translating complex electromagnetic requirements into measurable subsystem
specifications and defining the comprehensive EMC Control Plan.
You will lead advanced electromagnetic modeling to optimize antenna placement and mitigate interference, working closely with cross functional teams and suppliers to manage complex architectures for grounding, shielding, and cable segregation.
Ultimately, your technical leadership will ensure our mission-critical defense platforms operate flawlessly in the most demanding and contested electromagnetic environments.
 The day-to-day
 Own the end-to-end EMI/EMC engineering for an airborne platform, including the control plan, compliance roadmap, and integration strategy across all subsystems. 
 Translate platform-level electromagnetic environment requirements (intra/inter-system, external RF, lightning, HIRF, ESD, EMP) into measurable subsystem-level EMI/EMC requirements and KPIs. 
 Define and maintain the EMC Control Plan: grounding, bonding, shielding, filtering, and cable segregation philosophies. 
 Perform electromagnetic interference analysis across the platform: emissions/susceptibility, antenna-to-antenna coupling, co-site interference, and intermodulation between RF subsystems. 
 Lead EM modeling and simulation: antenna placement, cable coupling, shielding effectiveness, lightning indirect effects, and HIRF using tools such as CST, FEKO, HFSS, or equivalent. 
 Define zoning, bonding, and grounding architecture, including lightning protection and current return network for metallic and composite structures. 
 Support antenna integration and placement trade studies, including pattern degradation and isolation budgets. 
 Establish the EMI/EMC qualification and verification strategy against applicable standards (MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-464, DO-160, STANAG, or equivalent). 
 Own the EMI/EMC test campaign: plans, procedures, chamber and on-platform testing, and corrective actions. 
 Coordinate cross-functional design decisions with airframe, avionics, EW, comms, propulsion, power, and mission computing; manage EM trade-offs. 
 Own EMI/EMC-related interfaces and ICDs (grounding, shielding, filtering, connector specifications). 
 Manage supplier technical governance for EMI/EMC compliance and non-conformance closure. 
 You should apply if you
 Hold a relevant degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field. 
 Have proven experience in EMI/EMC engineering for airborne platforms with end-to-end ownership from requirements to certification. 
 Have a strong understanding of electromagnetic theory: transmission lines, antennas, wave propagation, shielding, grounding, and coupling mechanisms. 
 Can convert platform-level requirements into subsystem-level EMI/EMC specifications and verification criteria. 
 Are familiar with applicable standards and relevant NATO/STANAG or national military airworthiness frameworks. 
 Have hands-on experience with EM simulation tools for antenna placement, coupling, shielding effectiveness, HIRF, and lightning indirect effects analysis. 
 Have experience designing grounding, bonding, shielding, filtering, and cable segregation schemes for complex platforms, including composite structures. 
 Have defined and executed EMI/EMC test campaigns: chamber testing, on-platform ground tests, and flight test EMC verification, including instrumentation and data analysis. 
 Are comfortable leading cross-functional and supplier governance: reviewing EMC control plans, qualification evidence, ICDs, and driving issue closure with objective evidence. 
 Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.
 Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields 
 Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns 
 The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world 
 Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward 
 In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts 
 We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about 
 What We Offer
 Competitive salary and VSOP options 
 Relocation support: up to €2,500 and 4 weeks temporary accommodation 
 Learning: €500/£450 yearly allowance 
 Health & wellness: gym membership and mental health support (Nilo.health) 
 Social: regularly company events and monthly social allowances 
 Enhanced parental leave: 22 weeks fully paid for primary caregivers & 6 weeks for secondary caregivers. 
 Family support: 5 days of paid family emergency leave, 100% remote work option during pregnancy and phased return to work 
 These are the core benefits across all locations, there may be additional benefits in certain locations.
 Helsing is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

 Was tragen Sie bei?

 Im Projekt stimmen Sie elektrische, leittechnische und mechanische Schnittstellen zwischen den Lieferanten und anderen beteiligten Partnern ab.

Job Description:
 Für Airbus Defence & Space in Taufkirchen suchen wir einen
 Satellite Control Center (SCC) Systems Engineer HW/SW (d/m/w)
 zur Verstärkung des Teams System Delivery Germany . Die Abteilung entwickelt Satellitenkommunikationssysteme für zivile und militärische Kunden. Als SCC Systems Engineer HW/SW (d/m/w) arbeiten Sie am Konzept, Entwurf, der Entwicklung und der technischen Beschaffung von Satellitenkontrollzentren, deren Erweiterungen und Modifikationen für MILSATCOM sowie für kommerzielle Anwendungen. Darüber hinaus sind Sie für die Wartung der Satellitenkontrollzentren während der Routinephase der Programme verantwortlich.
Im Rahmen der Beschaffungsaktivitäten begleiten Sie die Entwicklungs- und Abnahmephase von der Ausschreibung (RFP) bis zur Endabnahme der Satellitenkontrollzentren. Nach der Abnahme begleiten Sie die Implementierung der Satellitenkontrollzentren in die Bodensegmente bis zur Inbetriebnahme. Während der Betriebsphase sind Sie der technische Ansprechpartner für eventuell auftretende Anomalien und unterstützen die technische Behebung der Probleme (Level-3-Support). Diese Position kombiniert Kenntnisse aus verschiedenen Disziplinen mit der Fähigkeit, über den Tellerrand hinauszuschauen.
 Ihr Standort
 Unser Standort liegt nur einen Steinwurf von München, der wunderschönen Landeshauptstadt Bayerns, entfernt. Sie begeistern sich für Sport und andere Outdoor-Aktivitäten? Die Alpen und der Starnberger See sind innerhalb einer Stunde erreichbar und bieten eine Vielzahl von Freizeitmöglichkeiten.
 Ihre Vorteile
 Attraktives Gehalt und Sonderzahlungen
 30 Tage Urlaub sowie Sonderurlaub für besondere Anlässe
 Hervorragende Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und großartige internationale, konzernweite Entwicklungsperspektiven
 Besondere Sozialleistungen: arbeitgeberfinanzierte Altersvorsorge, Mitarbeiteraktienoptionen, vergünstigtes Autoleasing, Sonderkonditionen für Versicherungen, Zuschüsse zum öffentlichen Nahverkehr, Mitarbeitervorteile bei Partnerunternehmen
 Einrichtungen vor Ort: Kindergarten in Standortnähe, Betriebsarzt für Vorsorgeuntersuchungen und andere gesundheitsbezogene Dienste, Kantine und Cafeteria, Fitnessstudio
 Vereinbarkeit von Familie & Beruf (Jobsharing, Teilzeitmodelle, flexible Arbeitszeiten, individuelle Auszeiten)
 Arbeiten in einem diversen Umfeld mit mehr als 140 Nationalitäten, in dem jede Stimme gehört wird
 Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten
 Requirements Engineering (Anforderungsmanagement) mit DOORS im Bereich des Satellitenkontrollzentrums und auf den darunter liegenden Ebenen
 Durchführung und Nachbereitung von Konzept- und Designaktivitäten im Bereich des Systems Engineering für Satellitenkontrollzentren, einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf Anforderungen, Schnittstellen, Nutzdaten- und Managementdatenflüsse innerhalb des Bodensegments sowie TM/TC-Schnittstellen
 Festlegung von Anforderungen für Hardware- (HW) und Software-Komponenten (SW) des Satellitenkontrollzentrums und deren Schnittstellen zu anderen Einheiten des Bodensegments, z. B. Erdfunkstellen, Payload Control Center, Netzwerke inkl. IT-Infrastruktur sowie Rechenzentren
 Ausarbeitung von System-Trade-offs im Bereich des Systems Engineering für Satellitenkontrollzentren und Unterstützung der Definition der Gesamtarchitektur
 Ausarbeitung des Verifikations- und Validierungskonzepts auf Ebene des Satellitenkontrollzentrums und Unterstützung relevanter Tests auf höherer Ebene (z. B. SVTs, GSVTs)
 Ausarbeitung des Betriebskonzepts sowie Erstellung von Betriebsanforderungen und Betriebsprodukten (Flight & Ground Operations Procedures, d. h. FOPs & GOPs) für das Satellitenkontrollzentrum
 Technische Unterstützung der Projektleiter bei der Planung, bei vertraglichen Änderungen sowie bei der Identifizierung von Risiken und Chancen
 Gewünschte Fähigkeiten und Qualifikationen
 Master-Abschluss in Telekommunikation, Elektronik oder einer anderen relevanten Ingenieursdisziplin
 Fundierte Erfahrung im Systems Engineering für Spacecraft Control Center und Payload Control Center
 Fundierte Kenntnisse im Systems Engineering für Satellitenkontrollzentren in Bezug auf technische Schnittstellen, Datenflüsse (für Nutz- und Managementdaten) sowie TM/TC-Engineering (gesichert und ungesichert)
 Ausgeprägte Erfahrung mit softwarebasierten Systemen, Netzwerken und IT-Infrastruktur
 Erfahrung im Bereich Erdfunkstellen-Engineering (Ground Station Engineering)
 Erfahrung in Design, Entwicklung, Integration, Verifikation und Betrieb von Satellitenkontrollzentren sowie den damit verbundenen Prozessen und Betriebsverfahren
 Kenntnisse der Nachrichtentechnik einschließlich HF-Link-Budgets und Antennendesigns wären von Vorteil
 Verhandlungssichere Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse
 Hinweis: Für diese Position ist eine Sicherheitsüberprüfung erforderlich bzw. die Voraussetzung, dass Sie für eine Überprüfung durch die anerkannten Behörden infrage kommen.

Dafür suchen wir Sie
 Flowsensoren zählen zu den wesentlichen Funktionskomponenten eines jeden Beatmungs- oder Anasthesiegerätes. Als Systemingenieur Sensorik (m/w/d) verantworten Sie die Entwicklung, Charakterisierung und Integration von Flow-Sensoren in komplexen pneumatischen Medizinprodukten — von der Anforderungsdefinition über die Systemintegration bis zur Verifikation und technischen Dokumentation.
Als Schnittstelle zwischen Komponenten- und Geräteentwicklung sind Sie Teil eines interdisziplinären Entwicklungsteams und sorgen dafür, dass unsere Flow-Sensorik unter realen klinischen Bedingungen präzise, robust und sicher funktioniert: bei unterschiedlichen Gasgemischen, Temperaturen, Feuchtigkeit, Kondensat, Leckagen und über den gesamten Lebenszyklus des Produkts.
 Ihre Aufgaben
 Entwicklung von Systemanforderungen und technischen Konzepten für Flow-Sensorik in Beatmungs- und Anästhesiegeräten. 
 Bewertung und Auswahl geeigneter Sensortechnologien hinsichtlich Genauigkeit, Robustheit und Leistungsfähigkeit. 
 Entwicklung der Sensorik in enger Abstimmung mit den Entwicklungsbereichen der Geräte. 
 Integration der Sensorik in komplexe pneumatische Systeme sowie Optimierung relevanter Systemeigenschaften. 
 Durchführung von Engineering Tests sowie Begleitung von Verifikations- und Validierungsaktivitäten. 
 Analyse von Messabweichungen und Entwicklung von Kompensations- und Diagnosekonzepten. 
 Durchführung von Risikoanalysen und Pflege der zugehörigen Entwicklungsdokumentation. 
 Zusammenarbeit mit Lieferanten und Unterstützung des Transfers in die Serienfertigung. 
 Das bringen Sie mit
 Abgeschlossenes Studium der Medizintechnik, Elektrotechnik, Mechatronik, Physik, des Maschinenbaus oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung. 
 Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Entwicklung, Charakterisierung oder Integration von Sensorik-, Mess- oder Durchflusssystemen. 
 Strukturierte, analytische Arbeitsweise sowie ausgeprägte interdisziplinäre Teamfähigkeit. 
 Fundierte Kenntnisse mindestens eines Flow-Messprinzips, idealerweise thermische Anemometrie, Differenzdruck oder MEMS-basierte Messverfahren. 
 Erfahrung in der Definition technischer Anforderungen sowie in Verifikations- und Testprozessen. 
 Sicherer Umgang mit Messdatenerfassung und statistischer Datenauswertung. 
 Gute Kenntnisse in mindestens einer Programmiersprache. 
 Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse. 
 Idealerweise verfügen Sie zusätzlich über:
 Erfahrung mit Flow-Sensorik in Beatmungs-, Anästhesie- oder vergleichbaren medizintechnischen Gasflusssystemen. 
 Kenntnisse in Pneumatik, Atemgasphysik und Kondensatmanagement. 
 Erfahrung mit Kalibrierstrategien, Driftkompensation und Signalverarbeitung. 
 Wissen zu Biokompatibilität, Reinigung, Desinfektion und Sterilisation von Medizinprodukten. 
 Ihr neuer Arbeitsplatz
 In Lübeck arbeiten rund 5.300 Menschen für Dräger. Hier lässt es sich gut leben. Die zweitgrößte Stadt (220.000 Einwohner) Schleswig-Holsteins bietet Ihnen eine hohe Wohnqualität, kurze Wege sowie viele Kultur- und Freizeitangebote. Von hier erreichen Sie in 20 Minuten die Ostsee und in nur einer Stunde die Elbmetropole Hamburg. Unsere Zentrale in der Moislinger Allee ist von viel Grün und Wasser umgeben. Historische Gebäude und moderne Architektur prägen das Bild. Zu Fuß erreichen Sie von hier in nur zehn Minuten die Lübecker Altstadt (UNESCO-Weltkulturerbe) und den Hauptbahnhof.
 Wer wir sind
 Vom Krankenhaus über die Industrie bis zur Feuerwehr verlassen sich Menschen weltweit auf unsere Produkte: hochmoderne Technik, die echte Ingenieurskunst mit der digitalen Zukunft verbindet. Mit über 130 Jahren an Erfahrung, Herzblut und den mutigen Ideen von mehr als 16.000 Mitarbeitenden setzen wir uns dafür ein, dass aus Technik ›Technik für das Leben‹ entsteht.
 Das finden Sie bei uns
 Attraktive Bezahlung nach jeweiligem Tarifvertrag inkl. diverser Sonderzahlungen
30 Tage Urlaubsanspruch plus betrieblich geregelte Sonderurlaubstage

Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability
 At Hypersonica , we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast.
By joining Hypersonica , you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously.
We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.
 What You'll Do
 Define seeker system requirements and manage interfaces with flight control, avionics, and ground segment teams. 
 Support seeker hardware/software integration and test campaigns. 
 Analyze test and flight data to validate seeker performance against requirements. 
 Collaborate with suppliers and partners on seeker component development and qualification. 
 Maintain technical documentation in line with requirements. 
 Design, model, and analyze seeker subsystem performance at the systems level (e.g. signal processing, detection/tracking performance). 
 Who You Are
 Degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Physics, or a related field. 
 Experience with sensor systems, signal processing, or guidance/tracking algorithms. 
 Familiarity with systems engineering methodology (requirements management, verification & validation). 
 Proficiency with MATLAB/Simulink or comparable modelling tools. 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 What We Offer
 A mission-driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security. 
 Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, and defence, with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow. 
 High ownership and autonomy; no time tracking, no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes. 
 A fast-paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from testing and operational activities drives real decisions. 
 A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly. 
 Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy. 
 Security and Eligibility Requirement 
 Due to the nature of the work done at Hypersonica, applicants must be an EU/Nato/German citizen and be eligible for Security Clearance.
At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply.
Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential.
You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. We review every application and aim to respond to all candidates within two weeks, whether the answer is yes or no.
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Who We Are
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.
As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.
We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.
 The role
 You will collaborate with a team developing the world’s first AI-enabled electronic warfare capability for a 4+ generation fighter jet—from concept to maiden flight. As an integral member of our chief engineering team, you will guide system engineering activities, spanning from aligning on and validating requirements with the customer to final system qualification and certification with aviation authorities. Your core focus will be to partner with our AI software specialists to ensure the developed EW software (airborne and ground) seamlessly meets customer needs and delivers exceptional operational impact.
The day-to-day
 Collaborate on system requirements with our customer to derive and validate high-level software requirements, ensuring our electronic warfare capabilities perfectly align with operational needs 
 Maintain comprehensive traceability from system requirements through to all software development artefacts, establishing clear technical product baselines alongside configuration management to guarantee certification readiness 
 Facilitate regular technical risk board meetings with software engineers to co-create risk mitigation strategies, effectively safeguarding project timelines and delivery quality 
 Ensure the meticulous planning of all technical deliverables in collaboration with project management, monitoring implementation progress to guide the team towards a successful first flight 
 Oversee the preparation of all technical documents to guarantee they meet rigorous compliance and certification standards, authorising them prior to customer delivery 
 Manage the final software product qualification and certification activities in partnership with both the customer and relevant aviation authorities, ensuring seamless deployment to active service 
 Partner with our quality assurance team to guarantee that all technical deliverables uphold established quality standards, promptly resolving any findings to preserve project integrity 
 Deliver clear and actionable updates on project status and technical changes to Chief Engineering and Programme Management, empowering stakeholders to make informed, timely decisions
 You should apply if you
 Have delivered software-intensive avionics or electronic warfare systems from conceptual design through to successful first flight
 Demonstrate extensive expertise in developing embedded software for avionics systems in accordance with DO-178C and ARP4754B, covering the full lifecycle from initial requirements to software verification 
 Have cultivated trusted relationships with civil or military aviation authorities, including active participation in formal panel meetings or Stages of Involvement (SOI) 
 Communicate complex technical concepts clearly and accessibly, ensuring seamless alignment between internal engineering teams and external stakeholders 
 Nice to Have
 Hold a degree in aerospace engineering, electrical engineering, physics, computer science, or a related discipline equipping you with a thorough technical understanding of complex systems 
 Familiarity with the integration of modern AI or machine learning models into highly regulated aerospace environments 
 Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields 
 Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns 
 The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world 
 Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward 
 In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts 
 We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about 
 What we offer
 Competitive salary and VSOP options 
 Relocation support: up to €2,500 and 4 weeks temporary accommodation 
 Learning: €500/£450 yearly allowance 
 Health & wellness: gym membership and mental health support (Nilo.health) 
 Social: regular company events and monthly social allowances 
 Enhanced parental leave: 22 weeks fully paid for primary caregivers & 6 weeks for secondary caregivers 
 Family support: 5 days of paid family emergency leave, 100% remote work option during pregnancy and phased return to work 
 These are the core benefits across all locations, there may be additional benefits in certain locations.
 Helsing is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

A Snapshot of Your Day 
 As an Electrical Systems Engineer for Execution of Power Plant Projects you would start a typical day with the organization of tasks to support your international project. You will work with a distributed team to build the basis of the Transition towards Balanced Energy by crafting user-friendly and coordinated power plant machinery like Power Control Centers, Static Excitation Systems, Startup Frequency Converters, Protective Relaying Systems, and Low Voltage Power Distribution Systems.
 How You’ll Make An Impact
 Conducting electrical engineering initiatives in international projects focused on the digitalization of Gas and Steam Turbine Power Plants,
 using COMOS as the primary digitalization platform for the automated generation of single line diagrams, interconnection diagrams, and the digital creation of circuit manuals
 Collaborating with suppliers on producing wiring drawings, single line diagrams, schematics, and data sheets, ensuring accuracy and compliance with project specifications
 Taking responsibility for defining component requirements and designing electrical auxiliaries for Gas Turbines, Steam Turbines, and Generators throughout project execution based on proposal documents, engineering standards and contract
 Developing and managing cable and termination information using digitalization platforms such as COMOS and plant design software to enhance project efficiency and accuracy
 Preparing and issuing equipment specifications and procurement documents to facilitate the acquisition of necessary components as well as participating in factory acceptance tests for electrical equipment, ensuring that all products meet the required standards and specifications before deployment
 Conducting bid evaluations of vendors and engaging in technical discussions with vendors to ensure alignment with project requirements
 What You Bring
 A bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical engineering (or a related field) or equivalent experience in the field of energy engineering
 Basic knowledge of Gas and Steam Turbine Power Plants, and digitalization platforms such as COMOS, plant design software and TIA Por-tal as well as basic experience in engineering and project execution for Electrical Systems
 Basic knowledge of Electrical Systems including LV/MV Switchgears, Battery Chargers, Cables and Cable Raceway Systems, Power Control Centers (PCCs, E-Houses), Generator and Transformer Protection, Synchronization, SEE (Static Excitation Systems), SFC (Starting Frequency Converters) and LV Transformers is an advantage
 Creativity, teamwork skills, open personality
 Willingness to travel up to 5% to engage with vendors, client offices, and project sites
 Proficiency in both German and English, with very good communication skills in both languages 
 About The Team
 Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and
decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof,
steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings,
modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.
 Who is Siemens Energy? 
 At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
 Our Commitment to Diversity
 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
 Rewards/Benefits
 In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
 We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
 We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
 The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
 In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical 
 We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.
https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

ADB SAFEGATE is a company that provides integrated solutions to airports, airlines, and ANSPs.
We are proud to be leading the way with innovative and smart Airside 4.0 solutions that turn airports into smart airports, with the ultimate goal of enhancing the passenger experience. Solutions include airfield lighting, power and control systems, airport and tower software, docking automation, apron management, and aftermarket services.
With over 1,400 employees and over 2,500 airports in over 175 countries, from the busiest and largest to the fastest-growing airports, ADB SAFEGATE is dedicated to making air travel safe, efficient, and environmentally friendly.
To learn more about ADB SAFEGATE and our innovative Airside 4.0 solutions, please visit our website at adbsafegate.com. Mission
As a Junior System Engineer, you will support the configuration, validation, deployment and testing of Airfield Lighting Control and Monitoring Systems (ALCMS). Working alongside experienced engineers, you will develop the practical skills needed to deliver reliable systems for airport customers.
You will contribute throughout the project lifecycle, from design support and system configuration to cabinet set-up, testing and on-site commissioning. ADB SAFEGATE provides structured on-the-job training to help early-career engineers become familiar with applicable regulations, standards, products and airfield operations. As your experience grows, you will take increasing ownership of technical tasks and customer-facing activities.
 Responsibilities
 Project engineering support
 Support projects from production release through testing, commissioning and customer acceptance.
 Plan and complete assigned tasks and milestones with guidance from a senior engineer or project lead.
 Assist project engineers and customers with system configuration, testing and troubleshooting.
 Provide clear and timely updates on progress, risks and technical issues.
 Collaborate with airport authorities, maintenance teams, contractors and internal stakeholders.
 Maintain project documentation and follow established engineering, quality and safety processes.
 Software
 Configure ADB SAFEGATE proprietary software using established procedures and project requirements.
 Install, configure and troubleshoot Windows and Linux-based systems at a foundational level.
 Configure commercially available software and connected hardware.
 Support minor software or configuration changes under supervision and document the changes clearly.
 Hardware
 Assist with the selection, preparation and configuration of suitable system hardware.
 Perform basic network configuration and troubleshooting, including IP addressing, subnet masks, gateways, Ethernet connections and connectivity checks.
 Read system schematics, network diagrams and cabinet drawings with support from experienced colleagues.
 Support hardware integration, cabinet testing and on-site commissioning of the complete ALCS.
 Testing and Validation Support
 Prepare and execute test plans, checklists and test records in accordance with defined processes.
 Support Factory Quality Tests, Factory Acceptance Tests, Site Acceptance Tests and customer training.
 Test operating systems, application software, interfaces and system management tools.
 Record defects accurately, support root-cause analysis and verify corrective actions.
 Follow local and international safety and quality requirements during testing and commissioning.
 Technical Drawings and Documentation
 Open, review and make basic updates to AutoCAD / pdf drawings, such as layouts, labels, layers and simple wiring or network details.
 Keep system documentation, configuration records, drawings and test evidence accurate and up to date.
 Your Profile
Personal competencies
 Curious, motivated and willing to learn new technologies and engineering practices.
 Structured and detail-oriented, with a commitment to completing tasks to a high quality standard.
 Comfortable asking questions, receiving feedback and working under the guidance of experienced colleagues.
 A practical problem-solving mindset and a responsible, can-do attitude.
 Clear communication skills and the ability to work cooperatively in an international, cross-functional team.
 Customer-oriented and professional when working on site.
 Willingness to travel domestically and internationally, including assignments of more than seven days, up to approximately 30% of working time.
 Required Qualifications & Skills
 Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Industrial Automation, Computer Engineering or a comparable technical discipline. Recent graduates and candidates with initial relevant experience are encouraged to apply.
 Foundational practical knowledge of Windows and/or Linux, such as installation, user and file management, basic services, command-line use and troubleshooting.
 Basic understanding of computer networks, including Ethernet, TCP/IP, IP addresses, subnet masks, gateways and common connectivity checks.
 Basic ability to read and make simple changes in AutoCAD drawings.
 Basic understanding of electrical or automation systems, system schematics and hardware interfaces.
 Initial exposure to PLCs, TIA Portal, Siemens S7 or industrial communication protocols such as Profibus, Modbus, CAN bus or PROFINET is an advantage.
 Ability to organize assigned work, manage priorities and communicate when support or escalation is needed.
 Any internship, university project, vocational training or hands-on technical experience in automation, IT, electrical systems or commissioning is an advantage.
 Languages
 Professional working proficiency in German and English.

items.jobDescription:
Ihre Aufgaben:
 Konstruktion und Auslegung von Stromlaufplänen sowie elektrischer Anlagenkomponenten
 Projektierung elektrotechnischer Anlagen unter Einhaltung von relevanten Normen, Richtlinien und Vorschriften mit den ECAD-Systemen EPLAN Electric P8 und EPLAN Pro Panel
 Erstellung von Bauteileplänen unter Berücksichtigung der Funktion mit AutoCAD/Solid Edge
 Konstruktive Untersuchungen der Kabelverlegewege mit dem 3D-CAD-System EPLAN Cable proD
 Termingerechte Vorbereitung der Teileaufstellungen für die Fertigung/den Einkauf
 Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den angrenzenden Abteilungen, wie z.B. mechanische Projektabwicklung, Fertigung, Montage und Inbetriebnahme
 Erstellung und Bearbeitung von technischen Dokumentationen sowie Revisionsbearbeitung
 Ihr Profil:
 Abgeschlossene elektrotechnische Berufsausbildung mit einer weiterführenden Qualifikation als Techniker, Meister oder Ingenieur bzw. Bachelor
 Berufserfahrung im oben genannten Bereich ist von Vorteil, Berufseinsteiger sind jedoch ebenfalls herzlich willkommen
 Kenntnisse in den Anwendungen EPLAN, AutoCAD und SolidEdge
 Kenntnisse mit Microsoft Office Produkte
 Interdisziplinäres Denken und Handeln sowie eine eigenständige Arbeitsweise und Kreativität bei der Lösungsfindung
 Teamfähigkeit sowie sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse runden Ihr Profil ab
 Unser Angebot
Als ein seit über 135 Jahren erfolgreich am Markt agierendes Unternehmen bieten wir Ihnen einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz und abwechslungsreiche Projekte in einer dynamischen, expandierenden Branche. Ein durchdachtes Onboarding hilft Ihnen beim Start und integriert Sie schnell ins Unternehmen.
Ein Unternehmen ist immer nur so gut wie seine Mitarbeiter. Das wissen wir bei psb und engagieren uns, um ein angenehmes Arbeitsklima zu schaffen sowie die gute Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben zu gewährleisten. Dafür bieten wir unseren Mitarbeitern folgende Benefits:
 Attraktive betriebliche Altersvorsorge
 Eigene Kantine mit Bezuschussung
 Einarbeitung mit Patenkonzept
 Günstiges JobRad Fahrradleasing
 Kostenlose E-Ladesäulen
 Homeoffice / flexible Arbeitszeiten
 Klimatisierte Arbeitsplätze
 Vergünstigte Fitnessstudios
 Nachlässe bei Eintrittstickets, beim Online-Shopping
 Interesse geweckt?
Dann freuen wir uns über Ihre aussagekräftige Bewerbung an unsere Personalabteilung, Frau Jasmin Forseth oder füllen Sie gleich unser Bewerbungsformular aus.

WEN WIR SUCHEN 
 Bei GETEC ist unser Antrieb der Sinn und unsere Kraft sind die Menschen. Wir suchen leidenschaftliche, vorausschauende Menschen, die Teamarbeit schätzen, Verantwortung übernehmen und etwas bewirken wollen. Wenn du dich in einem kollaborativen Umfeld wohlfühlst, Innovation schätzt und bereit bist, die Zukunft der Energie und Nachhaltigkeit zu gestalten, passt du genau zu uns. Unterstütze uns dabei, die Dekarbonisierung und die digitale Energiewende in Europa voranzutreiben.
 DEINE ZUKÜNFTIGE AUFGABE
 Das Programmieren und Inbetriebnehmen von Steuerungen und Regelungen sowie die Einbindung der Komponenten vor Ort in die Steuerungen wissen wir bestens bei Dir aufgehoben.
 Du bist für das Warten, Prüfen und Optimieren von Anlagen und für das Erstellen und bearbeiten von Schaltplänen und Verdrahtungsunterlagen verantwortlich.
 Der Aufbau von Schaltschränken, Verlegen von Leitungen und das Anschließen von Sensoren/Aktoren liegt in Deinen Händen.
 Du bist für das Parametrieren von Antrieben, Sensoren und Bussystemen (zb. Mbus, Modbus) sowie für die regelmäßigen Funktionsprüfungen und DGUV V3-konforme Messungen zuständig.
 Die Fehleranalyse in SPS-Programmen und Antriebsregelungen runden Dein Aufgabengebiet ab.
 DU ALS MENSCH UND WAS DU MITBRINGST
 Du hast eine erfolgreich abgeschlossene, technische Ausbildung im Bereich Elektrotechnik.

 Du hast eine Weiterbildung als Elektrofachkraft.
 Du konntest bereits Berufserfahrung in der SPS-Programmierung sammeln.

 Du bist kommunikativ und arbeitest selbstständig.
 Du bist mit einem Führerschein der Klasse B flexibel einsetzbar.

 Du hast bei uns die Möglichkeit, die Energiewende aktiv mitzugestalten.

 Wir ermöglichen Dir eine gute Work-Life-Balance durch eine flexible Arbeitszeitplanung mit Gleitzeit sowie 30 Urlaubstagen im Jahr.
 Wir fördern die bundesweite, nachhaltige Mobilität und bezuschussen das Deutschlandticket für unsere Mitarbeiter - damit Du unterwegs noch flexibler bist.

 Freue Dich auf die Nutzung zahlreicher Fitness- und Wellness-Angebote bei einer Mitgliedschaft über unseren Kooperationspartner Hansefit.

 Die Atmosphäre ist Dir wichtig? – Agiles Arbeiten und moderne Bürokonzepte sind für uns eine Selbstverständlichkeit.
 Durch unser Corporate Benefit Portal erhältst Du Zugang zu verschiedenen Vergünstigungen bei über 800 namhaften Produkt- und Eventanbietern.
 DRIVEN BY PURPOSE, POWERED BY PEOPLE

Über die Position 
 Für unseren Produktionsstandort in Bad Honnef suchen wir dich als Ingenieur Elektrotechnik für Transformatoren (w/m/d).
In dieser Rolle unterstützt du die elektrische Auslegung unserer kundenspezifischen Großtransformatoren.
Du verbindest technisches Verständnis mit wirtschaftlichem Denken und stellst sicher, dass Kundenanforderungen praxisnah und kostenbewusst umgesetzt werden. Auch bei komplexeren Aufgaben arbeitest du strukturiert und stimmst dich konstruktiv mit internen und externen Schnittstellen ab.
Du möchtest an technisch anspruchsvollen Produkten arbeiten und aktiv zur Energiewende beitragen? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!
 Das kannst du bewirken 
 Du arbeitest an der elektrischen Auslegung kundenspezifischer Großtransformatoren, z. B. mit Blick auf Spannungsfestigkeit, Verluste, Erwärmung, Geräusche und Isolationskonzepte
 Du unterstützt bei Angebots‑ und Auftragsberechnungen sowie bei Kosten‑ und Variantenkalkulationen unter technischen und wirtschaftlichen Gesichtspunkten
 Du analysierst technische Kundenanforderungen, leitest passende Auslegungskonzepte ab und prüfst deren Umsetzbarkeit in der Fertigung
 Du arbeitest eng mit Vertrieb, Einkauf, Fertigung, Qualität und Prüffeld zusammen und unterstützt bei technischen Fragestellungen
 Du begleitest die technische Klärung von Kundenanforderungen von der Angebotsphase bis zur Umsetzung
 Du bringst dich in lokale und internationale Entwicklungs‑ und Verbesserungsprojekte ein
 Du unterstützt bei der Auswertung von Testergebnissen, Abweichungen und technischen Optimierungspotenzialen
 Das bringst du mit 
 Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Elektrotechnik, idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt Energietechnik
 Du bringst idealerweise Erfahrung in der elektrischen Auslegung von Transformatoren mit – gerne geben wir auch Einsteigern die Möglichkeit, sich in dieses Thema einzuarbeiten
 Du gehst sicher mit MS Office (insbesondere Excel) um; Kenntnisse in AutoCAD sind von Vorteil
 Du kommunizierst auf Deutsch und Englisch
 Du arbeitest analytisch, sorgfältig und bringst ein gutes Kostenbewusstsein mit
 Du bist teamorientiert, lernbereit und gehst Aufgaben proaktiv und lösungsorientiert an

items.jobTitle: Junior Ingenieur (w/m/d) Elektrotechnik für Mobility Projekte
items.jobDescription:
Gemeinsam machen wir den Unterschied
 Siemens Mobility ist ein eigenständig geführtes Unternehmen der Siemens AG und seit über 160 Jahren ein führender Anbieter im Bereich Mobilität. Zu unserem Kerngeschäft gehören Schienenfahrzeuge, Bahnautomatisierungs- und Elektrifizierungslösungen, schlüsselfertige Systeme sowie die dazugehörigen Serviceleistungen. Wir waren schon immer sehr innovativ, um Reisen schneller, sicherer und komfortabler zu machen. Heute brauchen wir neue Lösungen für neue Herausforderungen wie den Klimawandel und weltweit steigende Bevölkerungszahlen. Das ist es, was uns antreibt. Deshalb gestalten wir Mobilität mit Leidenschaft und sind immer einen Schritt voraus. Durch Digitalisierung machen wir Infrastrukturen intelligent und schaffen Möglichkeiten, die uns nachhaltig und nahtlos von A nach B bringen. Unsere über 40.000 Mitarbeitende sind Pioniere im Mobilitätswesen, die dabei helfen, die Welt in Bewegung zu halten.
 Was trägst Du bei?
 Dein Weg führt Dich in das „Expert House“ von Siemens Mobility, das nationale und internationale Projekte auf dem Gebiet der Bahntechnik durchführt, z.B. bei den neuen Generationen von batterie- oder wassersstoffbetriebenen Zügen.
 Fachlich legst Du Deinen Schwerpunkt auf Inbetriebsetzung, Systemintegration, Gewährleistung und/oder Instandhaltung. 
 Dabei übernimmst Du die Schnittstellenklärung mit Projektbeteiligten und unterstützt die Projektleitung.
 Du führst selbständig Störungsanalysen und Fehlerbehebungen an den Schienenfahrzeugen durch. Hierbei wirst Du durch innovative IT-Systeme unterstützt. Des Weiteren wirkst du bei Kundenabnahmen mit. 
 Du erhältst eine umfassende Einarbeitung und wirst durch Trainings und Weiterbildungen gezielt gefördert. Wir machen Dich zur Expertin oder zum Experten der Zukunftsbranche Bahn.
 Deine Einsatzorte sind insbesondere unsere Eisenbahn-Depots in aller Welt, die Werkstätten unserer Partner oder unser Prüfcenter Wildenrath. 
 Durch Deine Tätigkeit im Expert House lernst Du verschiedenste Bereiche in unserem Unternehmen kennen. Das eröffnet Dir vielfältige Chancen für Deine Entwicklung – ebenso persönlich wie auch im Hinblick auf Deine Karriere bei Siemens Mobility.
 Was bringst Du mit?
 Du bist genau der/die Richtige für uns, wenn Du ein Bachelor-Studium in Elektrotechnik oder Mechatronik abgeschlossen hast. 
 Wenn Du schon erste Berufserfahrung in der Instandhaltung/Inbetriebnahme oder im Engineering (z.B. durch eine Werkstudententätigkeit) gesammelt hast, wäre das von Vorteil.
 Du liebst es für mehrere Monate zu reisen und bist bereit auch ggf. Schichtdienst an den entsprechenden Einsatzorten zu übernehmen.
 Für Deine neue Aufgabe auf internationaler Bühne bringst Du gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse mit.
 Außerdem bist Du im Besitz eines Führerscheins Klasse B.
 Was bieten wir Dir?
 Attraktive Konditionen
Du erhälst ein attraktives Vergütungspaket einschließlich der Leistungen des Tarifvertrages (z.B. Zusatzentgelte und Urlaubsgeld) und weiteren Extras (z.B. betriebliche Altersvorsorge und Aktienprogramm).
Vielfalt & Internationalität
Wir sind Weltunternehmer und auf allen fünf Kontinenten aktiv. Wir arbeiten für Kunden in aller Welt in internationalen Projekten. Deshalb legen wir in unseren Teams größten Wert auf Inklusion und fördern Vielfalt in all ihren Dimensionen.
Weiterentwicklung
Wir bieten Dir umfassende Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten für Deine berufliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung. Mit unserem Learning Campus verfügen wir über einen Inhouse-Dienstleister mit einem vielfältigen On- und Offline-Angebot.
Eine Übersicht über unsere Benefits findest Du hier.

www.siemens.com/de/de/unternehmen/jobs/faq.html
wenn Du Informationen rund um das Thema Bewerbung mittels unseres FAQ’s einholen möchtest.

 www.siemens.com/mobility-jobs
 wenn Du mehr Informationen zu Jobs & Karriere bei Siemens erhalten möchtest.

Fachplaner TGA (m/w/d) Elektrotechnik
 BWE - Regionalbüro Papenburg
 BWE - Standort Nottuln
 BWE - Standort Wildau
 Bei BWE entwickeln Sie elektrotechnische Konzepte für einige der technisch anspruchsvollsten Gebäude Deutschlands. Von Krankenhäusern mit höchsten Anforderungen an Verfügbarkeit und Versorgungssicherheit über Schulen und Kitas bis hin zu Justizvollzugsanstalten mit komplexen Sicherheits- und Infrastrukturkonzepten. Hier gestalten Sie Lösungen, die weit über Standard-TGA hinausgehen und begleiten Projekte von der Idee bis zur Realisierung.
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams der Standorten Wildau, Nottuln oder Papenburg suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Fachplaner TGA (m/w/d) Schwerpunkt Elektrotechnik.
Ihre Aufgaben
 Planung und Konzeption elektrotechnischer Anlagen in den Bereichen Starkstrom-, Fernmelde- und Informationstechnik sowie Fördertechnik
 Erstellung von Berechnungen, Schemen und Planungsunterlagen in den Leistungsphasen 1 bis 5 nach HOAI
 Mitwirkung bei Ausschreibungen sowie Bewertung und Auswertung von Angeboten
 Abstimmung mit Bauherren, Architekten, Fachplanern, Versorgern und weiteren Projektbeteiligten
 Termin- und Kostenkontrolle innerhalb Ihrer Projekte
 Begleitung der Bauausführung und Unterstützung in der Objektüberwachung
 Das bringen Sie mit
 Studium der Elektrotechnik oder eine Weiterbildung zum Techniker bzw. Meister Elektrotechnik
 Erfahrung in der Planung elektrotechnischer Anlagen innerhalb der TGA oder des Hochbaus
 Sicherer Umgang mit modernen Planungstools, idealerweise Autodesk Revit, ETAP oder Caneco
 Strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise
 Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit
 Auch Berufseinsteiger mit hoher technischer Affinität und Motivation sind willkommen.
 Wir bieten
 Anspruchsvolle Neubau- und Sanierungsprojekte bei denen Sie Ihre Ideen aktiv in die Planung einbringen können.

items.jobTitle: Junior Ingenieur (w/m/d) Elektrotechnik für Mobility Projekte
items.jobDescription:
Gemeinsam machen wir den Unterschied
 Siemens Mobility ist ein eigenständig geführtes Unternehmen der Siemens AG und seit über 160 Jahren ein führender Anbieter im Bereich Mobilität. Zu unserem Kerngeschäft gehören Schienenfahrzeuge, Bahnautomatisierungs- und Elektrifizierungslösungen, schlüsselfertige Systeme sowie die dazugehörigen Serviceleistungen. Wir waren schon immer sehr innovativ, um Reisen schneller, sicherer und komfortabler zu machen. Heute brauchen wir neue Lösungen für neue Herausforderungen wie den Klimawandel und weltweit steigende Bevölkerungszahlen. Das ist es, was uns antreibt. Deshalb gestalten wir Mobilität mit Leidenschaft und sind immer einen Schritt voraus. Durch Digitalisierung machen wir Infrastrukturen intelligent und schaffen Möglichkeiten, die uns nachhaltig und nahtlos von A nach B bringen. Unsere über 40.000 Mitarbeitenden sind Pioniere im Mobilitätswesen, die dabei helfen, die Welt in Bewegung zu halten.
 Was trägst Du bei?
 Dein Weg führt Dich in das „Expert House“ von Siemens Mobility, das nationale und internationale Projekte auf dem Gebiet der Bahntechnik durchführt, z.B. bei den neuen Generationen von batterie- oder wassersstoffbetriebenen Zügen.
 Fachlich legst Du Deinen Schwerpunkt auf Inbetriebsetzung, Systemintegration, Gewährleistung und/oder Instandhaltung.
 Dabei übernimmst Du die Schnittstellenklärung mit Projektbeteiligten und unterstützt die Projektleitung.
 Du führst selbständig Störungsanalysen und Fehlerbehebungen an den Schienenfahrzeugen durch. Hierbei wirst Du durch innovative IT-Systeme unterstützt. Des Weiteren wirkst du bei Kundenabnahmen mit.
 Du erhältst eine umfassende Einarbeitung und wirst durch Trainings und Weiterbildungen gezielt gefördert. Wir machen Dich zur Expertin oder zum Experten der Zukunftsbranche Bahn.
 Deine Einsatzorte sind insbesondere unsere Eisenbahn-Depots in aller Welt, die Werkstätten unserer Partner oder unser Prüfcenter Wildenrath.
 Durch Deine Tätigkeit im Expert House lernst Du verschiedenste Bereiche in unserem Unternehmen kennen. Das eröffnet Dir vielfältige Chancen für Deine Entwicklung – ebenso persönlich wie auch im Hinblick auf Deine Karriere bei Siemens Mobility.
 Was bringst Du mit?
 Du bist genau der/die Richtige für uns, wenn Du ein Bachelor-Studium in Elektrotechnik oder Mechatronik abgeschlossen hast.
 Wenn Du schon erste Berufserfahrung in der Instandhaltung/Inbetriebnahme oder im Engineering (z.B. durch eine Werkstudententätigkeit) gesammelt hast, wäre das von Vorteil.
 Du liebst es für mehrere Monate zu reisen und bist bereit auch ggf. Schichtdienst an den entsprechenden Einsatzorten zu übernehmen.
 Für Deine neue Aufgabe auf internationaler Bühne bringst Du gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse mit.
 Außerdem bist Du im Besitz eines Führerscheins Klasse B.
 Was bieten wir Dir?
 Inklusion & Vielfalt
Bei Siemens Mobility setzen wir uns engagiert für Gerechtigkeit und Gleichberechtigung ein. Vielfalt bereichert unser Team und fördert innovative Lösungen. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Behinderung.
Attraktive Konditionen
Du erhältst ein attraktives Vergütungspaket einschließlich der Leistungen des Tarifvertrages (z.B. Zusatzentgelte und Urlaubsgeld) und weiteren Extras (z.B. betriebliche Altersvorsorge und Aktienprogramm).
Weiterentwicklung
Wir bieten Dir umfassende Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten für Deine berufliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung. Mit unserem Learning Campus verfügen wir über einen Inhouse-Dienstleister mit einem vielfältigen On- und Offline-Angebot.
Eine Übersicht über unsere Benefits findest Du hier.

 www.siemens.com/mobility-jobs

Come join Analog Devices (ADI) – a place where Innovation meets Impact. For more than 55 years, Analog Devices has been inventing new breakthrough technologies that transform lives. At ADI you will work alongside the brightest minds to collaborate on solving complex problems that matter from autonomous vehicles, drones and factories to augmented reality and remote healthcare.
ADI fosters a culture that focuses on employees through beneficial programs, aligned goals, continuous learning opportunities, and practices that create a more sustainable future.
 About Analog Devices
 Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.
 The Opportunity
 Are you an engineer who enjoys understanding how complex systems work and turning new technologies into real customer solutions?
As part of Analog Devices’ Early Career Program, you will join our Field Applications organization and develop toward a System Platform / technical specialist role.
 You will work alongside experienced Field Applications Engineers (FAE), Account Managers, customers, and ADI business units to understand system-level challenges and identify how ADI technologies can solve them. The role combines deep technical development with significant customer exposure, helping you build expertise while learning how customers design their next-generation platforms.
The Early Career Program includes technical training, hands-on projects, job shadowing, mentoring and direct customer engagement.
What you will develop
 Build deep technical expertise in selected system platforms and technologies
 Understand customer architectures, requirements and technical challenges at system level
 Translate customer needs into system-level solutions
 Work closely with customers during evaluation, design and development
 Collaborate with ADI product and business teams to connect customer requirements with technology roadmaps
 Develop hands-on laboratory, measurement, debugging and prototyping skills
 Present technical concepts and solutions to customer engineering teams
 Share technical knowledge and best practices across the Field organization
 Build strong customer relationships through regular on-site customer engagement and shadowing
 Who we are looking for:
 Degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Embedded Systems, Telecommunications, Computer Engineering or a related discipline
 0-2years of professional experience
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
 Good understanding of electronic systems and willingness to develop broad system-level knowledge
 Hands-on mindset and interest in laboratory work, prototyping and debugging
 Curiosity for emerging technologies, including areas such as industrial automation, connectivity, sensing, signal processing, embedded software and AI at the edge
 Strong communication and collaboration skills
 Customer-oriented mindset and enthusiasm for working directly with engineers
 Ability to travel 25-40% of time
 Driving license
 Previous exposure to industrial applications is a plus
 Where this can take you:
The goal of this track is to develop you into a customer-facing technical expert who can connect customer system challenges with ADI technologies and platforms.
 For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce - Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U.S. Department of State - Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) – may have to go through an export licensing review process.

Required Travel: Yes, 25% of the time

Come join Analog Devices (ADI) – a place where Innovation meets Impact. For more than 55 years, Analog Devices has been inventing new breakthrough technologies that transform lives. At ADI you will work alongside the brightest minds to collaborate on solving complex problems that matter from autonomous vehicles, drones and factories to augmented reality and remote healthcare.
ADI fosters a culture that focuses on employees through beneficial programs, aligned goals, continuous learning opportunities, and practices that create a more sustainable future.
 About Analog Devices
 Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.
Come join Analog Devices (ADI) – a place where Innovation meets Impact. For more than 55 years, Analog Devices has been inventing new breakthrough technologies that transform lives. At ADI you will work alongside the brightest minds to collaborate on solving complex problems that matter from autonomous vehicles, drones and factories to augmented reality and remote healthcare.
ADI fosters a culture that focuses on employees through beneficial programs, aligned goals, continuous learning opportunities, and practices that create a more sustainable future. 
 Graduate Field Applications Engineer: Invent What’s Next
 Analog Devices (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader at the intersection of the physical and digital worlds. Our technologies enable customers to sense, measure, connect and interpret the world around us—helping turn breakthrough ideas into meaningful impact at the Intelligent Edge
 About The Job
 You have spent years learning how technology works. Now help create what it can become. At ADI, you will join a global technology leader where engineering meets AI and the physical world. From day one, your ideas will matter as you experiment, build and solve alongside talented people creating technologies that transform how we move, work, communicate and care for the world around us.
Bring your curiosity, creativity and perspective to a team that values different ways of thinking. Whether your strengths are in electronics, software, data, AI or connecting ideas across disciplines, you will have the support, tools and freedom to turn bold ideas into working technology. You do not need to arrive with every answer; we are looking for people with the potential and determination to discover better ones.
As a Graduate Field Applications Engineer, you will work on meaningful challenges with customers shaping intelligent vehicles, robotics, industrial automation, healthcare, energy and connected systems. Experienced mentors and a global community will champion your growth, while giving you the ownership and visibility to make an impact. If you want to build technology with real-world purpose, learn quickly and help define the future of intelligent systems, you can do that here.
 Key Responsibilities
 Discover: Get inside a customer’s toughest engineering challenges and understand the system they are trying to create
 Invent: Combine ADI technologies, reference designs and your own ideas to shape solutions at the intersection of the physical and digital worlds
 Build: Turn concepts into working prototypes using evaluation boards, lab equipment, embedded code and simulation tools
 Experiment: Test, measure and iterate quickly learning from what works and what does not
 Solve: Debug real hardware and software issues, bringing in ADI specialists when a challenge calls for deeper expertise
 Influence: Help customer engineers make architecture and technology choices from first idea through qualification and production
 Demonstrate: Bring technology to life through compelling demos, workshops and technical presentations
 Connect: Work alongside Field Sales, applications, systems, product and research teams across ADI’s global network
 Shape what comes next: Bring customer insight and emerging technology trends back into ADI to influence future products and platforms
 The Graduate Program
 Your first 12-18 months are designed as an engineering launchpad not a classroom-only training scheme. You will learn by building, experimenting and solving real customer problems, with increasing ownership as your confidence grows. The programme includes:
 Hands-on projects across applications, systems engineering, product teams and customer-facing field roles
 Experience across sensing, signal processing, power, connectivity and embedded intelligence the technologies that give AI systems awareness of the physical world
 Lab challenges, rapid prototyping and structured debug using professional hardware and software tools
 Opportunities to contribute to live customer designs and create demos that make complex technology tangible
 Develop technical storytelling, customer collaboration, project leadership and commercial awareness
 Mentorship, an experienced Field Applications Engineer to shadow and access to ADI specialists worldwide
 Technical Qualifications
 Bachelor’s/ Master’s Degree in Electronic & Electrical Engineering or a related STEM discipline
 Foundation in analog, mixed-signal or digital electronics, including the ability to read schematics and reason about circuit behaviour valuable
 Practical exposure to electronics through university projects, a placement, a personal build, a robotics team, a hackathon or laboratory work
 Familiarity with at least one programming or engineering environment such as C, C++, Python or MATLAB; experience with AI-assisted engineering tools is welcome
 What You’ll Bring
 Curiosity about how things work and the drive to find better ways to build them
 Excitement about the convergence of electronics, software, data and AI
 A practical, resilient approach to open-ended problems: testing ideas, learning quickly and continuing when the first answer is not the right one
 The ability to explain technical ideas clearly and an interest in working with people as well as technology
 Curiosity about how engineering decisions create customer and business value, with an eagerness to develop sound commercial judgement
 The ambition to see your engineering move beyond the lab and become part of products used in the real world
 An inclusive, collaborative mindset and openness to working across disciplines, cultures and time zones
 Practical Requirements
 Fluency in English and the local language of the assigned territory; additional languages are highly valued
 A valid driving licence and passport, or the ability to obtain them before taking on independent customer responsibilities.
 Willingness to travel at least 25% of the time.
 What Success Looks Like
 You turn an ambitious idea into working technology building, testing and demonstrating a solution that creates real value for a customer.
 Customers trust your perspective because you understand their goals, their system and the technology that can move them forward.
 You help shape important design decisions, connecting technical possibilities with customer priorities and commercial opportunity.
 You become a confident problem-solver, drawing on the right people, tools and ideas from across ADI to overcome complex challenges.
 Your insight influences what ADI builds next, bringing customer needs and emerging technology trends back into the organisation.
 You complete the programme ready to lead customer engagements, take ownership and build a career creating technologies that matter and impactful business outcomes.
 What You Get In Return
 A strong start to your engineering career: A structured graduate program with meaningful work, clear development milestones and increasing responsibility
 World-class learning: Hands-on experience with leading-edge analog mixed signal, digital, software and AI-enabled technologies, supported by technical experts and experienced mentors
 Real impact from day one: The opportunity to contribute to customer products and technologies that shape mobility, automation, healthcare, energy and the connected world
 Global exposure: Collaboration with customers and colleagues across disciplines, cultures and markets, with opportunities to build an international network
 Career mobility: Broad experience and visibility across ADI, creating pathways into field applications, systems, product, technical sales and leadership roles
 A supportive community: A dedicated mentor, a global graduate network and an inclusive environment where your ideas and perspective are valued
 A competitive package: Competitive graduate compensation and benefits aligned with the role and local market

 Ersatzteile, Werkstatteinrichtung und Arbeitsmittel behalten bei Ihnen den richtigen Platz

Wir suchen daher Menschen, die Teil eines Familienunternehmens werden und mit uns gemeinsam für eine bessere Umwelt sorgen möchten.

 Eine langfristige Perspektive in unserem wirtschaftlich gesunden Familienunternehmen

items.jobTitle: Entwicklungsingenieur (w/m/d) Modulation of Modular Multilevel Converter
items.jobDescription:
A Snapshot of Your Day 
 As a development engineer at Siemens Energy, you will analyze and optimize modulation algorithms for power converters of the future to enable the energy transition and integrate more renewable energy into electrical grids.
You will abstract core challenges as well as hardware and software limitations for modulation. Together with a team of experts, you will shape continuous development as part of R&D and customer projects. You will investigate, implement and test solutions for these challenges and be able to efficiently program algorithms for real-time systems (DSP, SIMD, FPGA, AI engines).
 How You’ll Make An Impact
 Independently analyze non-PWM-based modulation concepts of self-commutated multilevel converters and understand the interaction with the control and design of the converter in own laboratory setups
 Support the development of novel modulation algorithms to drive modular multilevel converters, DC choppers and solid state breakers.
 Creating models for self-controlled multilevel converters in HVDC (high voltage direct current transmission), including interaction with controller design, test design, performing studies and documenting results
 Understand the need for a modular model and object-oriented testing architecture for flexible and agile development to achieve high development speed.
 Extend and design an automated, class-based test environment for functional testing of modules (Matlab/Simulink, OPAL, RTDS, test driven design)
 Provide technical support to internal business partners (engineering, product manager, sales, etc.)
 What You Bring
 Successfully completed university studies in the field of electrical engineering with a standard duration of more than 4 years and relevant professional experience in the field of power converter technology
 Sound knowledge of large object-oriented software projects and hardware-related programming (DSP, ARM, FPGA, AI engines)
 Expertise in automatic code generation with Matlab/Simulink for target systems (DSP, ARM, FPGA, AI engines) and execution on real-time systems as well as extensive simulations
 Knowledge of power electronics, energy technology, modulation and control of power converters
 Business fluent communication skills in German and English or are willing to further develop their language skills
 Structured way of working, initiative, creativity, teamwork, communication skills, motivation, enthusiasm and quality orientation round off your profile
 About The Team
 Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers,
and digital grid technology.
 Who is Siemens Energy? 
 At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
 Our Commitment to Diversity
 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
 Rewards/Benefits
 In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme 
 We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder 
 We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity 
 The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programs and learning materials are available for this purpose 
 In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical
 We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

items.jobTitle: Global Customer Application Engineer AC/DC microgrid
items.jobDescription:
At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
 This position reports to:
 Chapter Lead
__
 Your Role And Responsibilities
 We are looking for a Global Application Engineer with good know-how of controls for AC and DC microgrids, relevant experience in the key parts of a microgrid: solar PV, battery energy storage, AC/DC and DC/DC converters, electrical protection and grid connection, are considered valuable assets.
The role combines hands-on technical work, from reference architectures to testing, validation and project execution, with close customer contact on real projects, including DC microgrid pilots. You’ll be the link between customers, R&D, product management and research centers, bringing market needs into new developments and helping turn technical solutions into business.
Depending on your background, your focus will be either on grid-connected AC microgrids for industrial and commercial customers, or on DC microgrid installations and pilots.
Work model: Hybrid ( hybrid)
You will be mainly accountable for:
 Supporting customers and sales teams in industrial and commercial segments, from early technical discussions to solution proposals, for MG electrical & control systems serving solar PV, battery energy storage and variable loads.
 Developing and promoting reference architectures and application notes for AC and DC microgrids using ABB’s low voltage portfolio, converters and digital solutions.
 Planning and managing microgrid installations and pilot projects, from system design and panel solutions to commissioning support.
 Supporting development, testing and validation of applications, including supplier selection and purchasing.
 Working with R&D, product management, digital teams and research centers to bring market needs into new developments.
 Analyzing the competitive landscape and market trends and recommend adjustments to mid- and long-term strategy.
 Qualifications For The Role
 Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical engineering, with 4+ years of experience in microgrids systems.
 Practical experience with microgrid components such as controllers, converters/PCS, battery energy storage and solar PV, including their protection.
 Ability to read and work with multiline diagrams and technical specifications in tools such as AutoCAD or EPLAN.
 Technical sales or application engineering towards industrial and commercial customers.
 Electrical system design, panel building or project management of microgrid or similar installations.
 Knowledge of DC applications and grid codes is a plus.
 Electrical simulations using MATLAB Simulink is a plus
 Comfortable working with customers, with good negotiation and communication skills in English.
 Agile mindset and willingness to keep learning.
 Willingness to travel for short periods.
 Driving’s license.
 More About Us
 ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.
 This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive.
 The final offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.

Ready to make an impact?
Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.
